normalized_snapshots.purpose: Normalized comparison snapshots parsed by the Rust HTTP contract runner; these are not restorable raw ledger dumps.

transformation.description: Only missing SQL statement terminators were appended; all pre-existing bytes, INSERT statements, values, amounts, and digests were preserved.

standalone_sqlite_probe.limitation: Normalized meta.value drops the JSON storage layer. In particular, JSON text null becomes SQL NULL and violates the original NOT NULL constraint. INSERT content is intentionally retained for comparison semantics.
standalone_sqlite_probe.checks: Successful loads ran PRAGMA integrity_check and PRAGMA foreign_key_check; failed loads stopped before those checks.

raw_legacy_ledger.purpose: Restorable raw SQLite dump from the successful synthetic legacy-restart capture, without normalization.
